mapper.insert: insert into verification_code(purpose, target, code_hash, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) values(#{purpose}, #{target}, #{codeHash}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, purpose, target, code_hash, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from verification_code where purpose = #{purpose} and target = #{target} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by id desc limit 1

select id, purpose, target, code_hash, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from verification_code where purpose = #{purpose} and target = #{target} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'SENT') order by id desc limit 1

select id, purpose, target, code_hash, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from verification_code where purpose = #{purpose} and target = #{target} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update verification_code set attempt_count = case when attempt_count + 1 >= max_attempts then max_attempts else attempt_count + 1 end, status = case when attempt_count + 1 >= max_attempts then 'FROZEN' else 'ACTIVE' end, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'SENT')
